headline: Profit swings positive as Sterigenics, Nordion drive growth
summary_short: Revenue rose to $280M (+10.0% y/y, -7.7% q/q) as Sterigenics (+9.7%) and Nordion (+29.0%) revenue growth offset a slight Nelson Labs pullback; net income swung to $26.6M from a $13.3M loss a year ago, and the company reaffirmed unchanged FY2026 guidance of $1.233-$1.251B revenue and $632-$641M Adjusted EBITDA.
summary_long: Sterigenics revenue rose 9.7% to $186M on higher pricing, FX tailwind, and better volume/mix; segment income grew 9.6% to $96M, partly offset by higher costs. Nordion revenue jumped 29.0% to $42M and segment income rose 36.1% to $24M on favorable Co-60 harvest timing plus FX and pricing, partly offset by inflation. Nelson Labs revenue slipped 0.7% to $52M and segment income fell 11.5% to $15M on weaker volume/mix, partly offset by FX and pricing. Operating cash flow fell to $29M (vs $55.5M a year ago) after a $34M Illinois EO settlement payment; cash fell to $314M on $46M of capex. Sotera reaffirmed unchanged full-year 2026 guidance: $1.233-$1.251B revenue, $632-$641M Adjusted EBITDA.

drivers.explanation: Revenue rose 10.0% y/y as Sterigenics and Nordion delivered pricing, FX, and volume/mix gains; net income swung to $26.6M from a year-ago loss and the company reaffirmed unchanged FY2026 revenue and Adjusted EBITDA guidance.
Net revenues grew $25.5M y/y (+10.0%), driven by favorable pricing and volume/mix in Sterigenics and Nordion plus a broad FX benefit, partly offset by a Nelson Labs volume/mix decline.

Cost of revenues grew 11.7% on higher compensation, depreciation, and volume-driven material costs, slightly outpacing revenue growth, but gross profit still rose 8.6% y/y on the underlying volume and pricing gains.

Net income swung to $26.6M from a $13.3M loss a year ago, mainly on higher segment income and no repeat of the year-ago $30.9M Illinois EO litigation settlement charge, partly offset by a $16.0M tax provision versus a $1.6M benefit.
Diluted EPS moved to $0.09 from a $(0.05) loss per share in line with the net income swing; diluted share count rose modestly to 287.6M from 283.6M.
Adjusted EBITDA rose 10.5% y/y (6.9% constant currency) on Sterigenics and Nordion segment income growth, partly offset by Nelson Labs softness.
Operating cash flow fell to $29.4M from $55.5M a year ago, inclusive of a previously disclosed $34M cash payment to settle Illinois EO litigation.
Cash fell $30.5M q/q mainly on the $34.0M EO litigation settlement payment and $46.2M of capex, partly offset by $63.4M of operating cash flow excluding the settlement.
Equity grew on $26.6M of net income plus other comprehensive items, despite a $17.6M unfavorable foreign-currency-translation swing.
